description: Deliberately promote accepted Notion knowledge into a linked Linear hierarchy, with one batch approval.

evals.name: Promote an Idea to Linear
evals.prompt: Promote this idea to Linear: the CSV export idea we captured earlier in Notion.
evals.expected_output: Reads the source Idea, drafts the exact proposed Linear hierarchy (likely a single Issue for a narrow idea like this), presents it as one preview, and states it needs one batch approval before creating anything.

evals.name: Accept a Decision into execution
evals.prompt: Turn this accepted decision into tracked work: adopt the read-only mirror design for promptlibrary-kit.
evals.expected_output: Reads the source Decision, proposes the Linear hierarchy implied by it, and does not silently expand scope beyond what the Decision itself calls for.
